svg.title: FIG 05 · Room-Splits
svg.desc: Blueprint of Room-Splits, a Kotlin Multiplatform expense-sharing app. Android, iOS and Web (Wasm) share one Compose Multiplatform UI and one shared module (domain, data, MVI stores, Koin). The shared module keeps a local SQLDelight database for offline use and talks to a Ktor server on PostgreSQL through the Ktor client. Everything past the scaffold is planned and drawn dashed.
svg.text: share logic once, ship to android, ios and web · dashed parts are on the roadmap
phases: foundation → auth → groups → expenses + splits → balances + settle-up → offline sync, export, currency
clean architecture + mvi · coroutines + flow · kotlinx.serialization · github actions
